column1: # Ash Jenna confronts the party in Tolbi after Colosso.

column3:
You remember what I said
in Lamakan. The Wise One
has noticed you, too.{page_break}He will not let you reach
the next lighthouse
without watching.{end_wait}
Ash Jenna. We know what\nyou told us in Lamakan.\nWhy are you here?{end_wait}

I am watching what happens
when the next lighthouse
is lit.{page_break}The Wise One will be
waiting for you there. He
always is.{end_wait}
You said the Wise One\ndestroyed your world. Is\nthat what you fear here?{end_wait}
I know what follows when\nhe gets what he wants. You\nwill learn soon enough.{end_wait}
You came to frighten us.\nWe won't follow you\nblindly.{end_wait}
Still defending everyone,\nMia? You admitted you\nwanted the beast to suffer.{end_wait}
I was angry. I won't deny\nit. But you don't get to\nturn that into my nature.{end_wait}
Go to the next lighthouse,\nIsaac. You'll see what the\nWise One is hiding.{end_wait}
Wait! What happened to\nyour world? What did he\ndo?{end_wait}
